about: A white-hot dart (deadeyeBolt, slabBolt; sniper shots aimed ahead): white light, tinted per entity.
name: Bolt

bolt.png.prompt: Paint a thin dart of white-hot light flying to the right: a sharp bright white point on the right, a slim glowing body and a short fading tail of sparks trailing to the left, horizontal. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
